name: Xorothian Stardust
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
So you come to me seeking Xorothian stardust?  You wish to open a portal to Xoroth, the domain of Hel'nurath my rival?  Perhaps you plan to steal from him one of his precious dreadsteeds?

Very well.  My servant Ur'dan has a supply of Xorothian stardust.  You may obtain it from him... if you can pay the price.
narrative.objectives: Purchase Xorothian Stardust from Ur'dan.  Bring it to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.
narrative.offerRewardText:
There it is! I can hardly believe you got it! You must have struck a big deal with that Dreadlord or else paid a large sum, or both!

Mor'zul will have his ink very soon and then he can finally make the glyph parchment, so you can open a portal to Xoroth and pull through it one of the famed dreadsteeds!
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you been to Jaedenar, adventurer? Did you get the stardust from Lord Banehollow?

chain.subtitle: 5 quests from level 58 to 60, 32,200 XP in all.

quests.name: Lord Banehollow
quests.objectiveText: Purchase Shadowy Potions from Gorzeeki in the Burning Steppes. Use the potions to travel through Jaedenar, and speak with Lord Banehollow.

quests.name: Ulathek the Traitor
quests.objectiveText: Confront Ulathek, then bring The Traitor's Heart to Lord Banehollow in Jaedenar.

quests.name: Imp Delivery
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Imp in a Jar to the alchemy lab in the Scholomance.
